description: This PHP source file defines the MembershipAPI class, which manages CRUD operations for membership entities within an admin plugin. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting memberships, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: MembershipAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Membership entities, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, with integrated API documentation and validation rules.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the MembershipService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single membership by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all memberships with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing memberships.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves membership data, used by create and update methods.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a membership.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing membership identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a membership.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the name property, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes memberships based on provided IDs.
